title: Taanti
description: The bartender for the Mos Pelgo, and later Freetown, cantina, Taanti was a fixture of the settlement. He was present upon Cobb Vanth's first encounter with The Mandalorian, and took part in the fight against the Krayt Dragon. When Cad Bane gunned Vanth down, Taanti was one of the first people to reach the wounded marshal. He then led a group of Freetown volunteers to join the fight against the Pykes.
